_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. aaply.app is a Tilda site: the stylesheet declares almost no design tokens (only the --w* layout widths and --anim-nav), so nearly every leaf carries a measured "value" and names the measurement in "source" (an anchor of raw/measurements.md, written from raw/components-computed.json). A leaf with "var" takes its value from that custom property's resolved entry in css-vars.json. One theme: the public marketing site is light with a black footer band.

lime.description: #e6e51e, the signature aaply lime: primary CTA pills, the Plus plan card, the feature table card, footer-link text on black

lime-slide.description: #e7e51e, the featured review slide's lime (a hair off the CTA lime — Tilda tints it per-block)

black.description: pure #000: all body and display text, the dark CTA pills, the footer band

white.description: #fff: the floating nav bar, plan/review/value card fills, text on dark surfaces
